source: Official Gemini API pricing page, fetched 2026-10-25 (see hevi/capabilities/nano_banana.py docstring). Prices are Standard-tier per-image USD estimates. null means the price was NOT verified in that fetch and is never guessed.
source_note: This file is the single configured source for model ids and prices. Capabilities that bill against these models must read prices from here (via model_catalog.py), not keep a private copy. The one exception is the fallback literal inside nano_banana.py, used only if this file cannot be loaded.
